name: tally-glyph-counter
title: Tally Glyph Counter
description: Counts rendered as tally marks: groups of four vertical strokes with a diagonal fifth strike-through, animated stroke-by-stroke as the value ticks up — a counting display that predates numerals and still reads instantly.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Editorial
Macrostructure: Rail
Density: Dense
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Monospace
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Value Tick: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
